# Kessel Island Ferry: Winter Timetable 2026

Issued by the Kessel Harbour Office. Valid from 12 January to 29 March 2026.

## Daily sailings

| Sailing     | Leaves Kessel pier | Arrives Island quay | Leaves Island quay | Arrives Kessel pier |
|-------------|--------------------|---------------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| First boat  | 07:40              | 08:15               | 08:30              | 09:05               |
| Midday boat | 12:10              | 12:45               | 13:00              | 13:35               |
| Last boat   | 17:30              | 18:05               | 18:20              | 18:55               |

The crossing takes 35 minutes. The ferry's service speed is 18 km/h. It carries up
to 120 passengers and 8 cars.
